sources.entry: lucinate — Go-based terminal-native TUI chat client for interacting with AI agents via OpenClaw gateways, Hermes profiles, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Features streaming responses, markdown rendering, tool call cards, local skills, cron management, session browsing, and multi-agent support. MIT. → Website · Homebrew

summary.one_liner: lucinate is a Go terminal chat client (TUI) for talking to OpenClaw gateways, Hermes Agent profiles, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints such as Ollama, vLLM, and LM Studio.
summary.what_it_does: The app is a Bubble Tea terminal UI with streaming replies, markdown rendering, and mouse-wheel scrolling with click-drag copy. It supports three connection types: OpenClaw gateways over WebSocket with Ed25519 device pairing, OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoints, and Hermes Agent profiles via /v1/responses. Users can create and delete agents from the TUI, with OpenClaw agents managed by the gateway and OpenAI-compatible agents stored as local IDENTITY.md and SOUL.md files. Chat features include shell commands (! local, !! on the gateway), message queueing, local agent skills from ~/.agents/skills/, and routines (saved multi-step prompt sequences with auto or manual advance). OpenClaw-only features include tool call cards, live token and cost stats, /think levels, and a cron job browser. A one-shot `lucinate send` and `lucinate ask` mode print a single reply to stdout, and `lucinate chat` opens the TUI pre-navigated to a chosen connection and agent.
use_cases: chat with a local LLM from the terminal
talk to an OpenClaw agent without a browser
switch between multiple AI backends and agents
script a one-off prompt and capture the reply in a shell
browse and run OpenClaw cron jobs from the terminal
how_to_run: git clone <repo-url> && cd lucinate && go build -o lucinate .
notable: Single TUI covers OpenClaw gateways, Hermes profiles, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, switchable via /connections
Routines: save multi-step prompts as markdown files and replay them with auto-advance or manual stepping, works with every backend
Scripting modes: lucinate send prints only the reply to stdout, and lucinate ask adds saved defaults
Local skills from ~/.agents/skills/ can be invoked as slash commands or inline in a message
caveats: Many features (tool call cards, stats, /think, cron browser, /stats) apply only to OpenClaw backends
OpenClaw first use requires approving the device on the gateway host with the openclaw CLI
Hermes profiles must be created server-side with hermes profile create; the TUI cannot create them
keywords: talk to ai agent from terminal
